description: Catch up: everything a person or group did, and where they were named, in a window, newest first per kind (mail grouped by thread). who: a name (fuzzy; close matches return ambiguous [{name, hash}]), email, hash:<8 hex>, team:<slug>, org:<name>, new:<window>, a phrase ('the core team'), or a list. since/until: ISO date, today, 2w/14d/1m, pg19 (a release's development window), all; default 14 days. during: a calendar event uid/url. topic narrows by hybrid search. Kinds: waiting (one person, no topic: what is on their radar, each with group, priority 0-100 and why, and an outlook (a model's P(commit) for the CF and release, thread health, people to seek out) when its thread is in an open commitfest), mail_from, mail_to_cc, mail_mention, git_author, git_credit, git_mention, wiki_edit, wiki_mention, commitfest, calendar, roster. Names, page hashes and urls only, never addresses. ~4 s budget; late kinds go in timed_out with partial=true. Cite each item's url. Same as GET /api/v2/activity.

during.description: A calendar event uid or url, or pg19: sets since and until to its dates

since.description: Window start: 2026-10-01, 2w, 14d, 1m, today, pg19, all (default 14 days ago)

topic.description: Optional topic that narrows every kind, e.g. NUMA, benchmarking

who.description: Who: 'Tom Lane', 'team:core-team', 'org:Amazon/AWS', 'new:30d', a 8-hex person hash, an email; a string or a list of strings

name: whats_new
